commands:
if [ -f /etc/apt/apt-mirrors.txt ]; then
  sudo sed -i '\#azure.archive.ubuntu.com#d' /etc/apt/apt-mirrors.txt
fi
pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps ${{ inputs.playwright_browsers }}

if [[ '${{ inputs.increase_ulimit && runner.os != 'Windows' }}' == 'true' ]]; then
  ulimit -n 65536 || true
  printf 'Effective file descriptor limit: '
  ulimit -n || true
fi
node .github/scripts/ci-timing.mjs start main
trap 'phase_exit=$?; node .github/scripts/ci-timing.mjs finish main "$phase_exit"; exit "$phase_exit"' EXIT
if [[ -n "$PR_BASE_SHA" ]]; then
  export GITHUB_BASE_REF="$PR_BASE_SHA"
  export GITHUB_HEAD_REF="$PR_HEAD_REF"
fi
${{ inputs.main_command }}

with.main_command:
pnpm test:dependency-contracts
if [[ '${{ inputs.runs_on }}' == 'ubuntu-latest' && '${{ inputs.node_version }}' == '24' ]]; then
  pnpm exec vitest run --config scripts/vitest.config.mjs scripts/coverageShards scripts/testFixtures scripts/consumerArtifacts scripts/ci-timing.test.mjs scripts/ci-topology.test.mjs scripts/verification-history.test.mjs scripts/verificationBenchmark/ci/archive.test.mjs scripts/ci-types.test.mjs
fi

commands: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.mkdirSync('.tmp/verification-plan', { recursive: true }); const profile = { os: process.platform, arch: process.arch, nodeMajor: Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0]), provider: 'none', platform: 'weapp', runnerClass: 'github-hosted' }; fs.writeFileSync('.tmp/verification-plan/profile.json', JSON.stringify(profile)); fs.writeFileSync('.tmp/verification-plan/headless-profile.json', JSON.stringify({ ...profile, provider: 'headless' }));"

node --import tsx e2e/scripts/verification/cli.ts history --input=.tmp/verification-history --profile=.tmp/verification-plan/profile.json --repository="${{ github.repository }}" --workflow=.github/workflows/ci-e2e.yml --output=.tmp/verification-plan/history.json
node --import tsx e2e/scripts/verification/cli.ts plan --suite=ci-${{ inputs.mode }}:classic --shards=4 --profile=.tmp/verification-plan/profile.json --history=.tmp/verification-plan/history.json --output=.tmp/verification-plan/plan.json
node --import tsx e2e/scripts/verification/cli.ts history --input=.tmp/verification-history --profile=.tmp/verification-plan/headless-profile.json --repository="${{ github.repository }}" --workflow=.github/workflows/ci-e2e.yml --output=.tmp/verification-plan/headless-history.json
node --import tsx e2e/scripts/verification/cli.ts plan --suite=ide-dom-headless:classic --shards=2 --profile=.tmp/verification-plan/headless-profile.json --history=.tmp/verification-plan/headless-history.json --output=.tmp/verification-plan/ide-dom-headless.json

with.main_command:
